Retrieve the latest scholarly articles on a specified topic published since a given year. 
Raises: ValueError: If the start_year is in the future.

topic.description: The topic to search articles for, e.g., "quantum mechanics".

start_year.description: The year from which to start searching for articles.

articles.description: A list of articles, each represented by a dictionary containing title and author.

total_count.description: The total number of articles found.

tools.name: create_writing_schedule
tools.description:
Create a structured writing schedule for dissertation chapters leading up to a deadline. 
Raises: ValueError: If the deadline is in the past.

chapters.description: A list of chapter titles that need to be completed.

deadline.description: The date by which the dissertation must be submitted, format "YYYY-MM-DD".

schedule.description: A list of dictionaries containing chapter title and due date for each chapter.

total_chapters.description: The total number of chapters included in the schedule.

tools.name: get_article_details
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a specific scholarly article. 
Raises: ValueError: If the article_id is invalid.

article_id.description: The unique identifier for the article to retrieve details for.

publication_date.description: The date the article was published.

abstract.description: A brief summary of the article's content.

tools.name: check_submission_deadline
tools.description: Check if the submission of chapters can be completed by the deadline.

chapters.description: A list of chapter titles that need to be submitted.

current_date.description: The current date in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

can_submit.description: True if all chapters can be submitted by the deadline, False otherwise.

messages.content: Hi, can you help me list the latest scholarly articles on quantum mechanics published since 2020?

messages.name: list_latest_scholarly_articles
